items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: You asked me to bring this.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: Keep it with you. We're only working in the yard.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: Walk the new route. Tell me anything the crew will need moved before they start.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: There's cord across the way out. By the last screen.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: Yes. It goes round the foot there, too.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: Where is your crew going next?

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: A drainage tunnel. They're surveying it this afternoon.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: We're looking through the recordings Chae sent.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: If I find it in one, can you go there?

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: If the gate's still open. Which recordings?

items.speaker: MINHO
items.speaker_attribution_note: Tail approaches Minho from the clear space left of his jaw.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.speaker_attribution_note: Minho first; tail uses the gap to the right of his face.

items.speaker: NIB
items.speaker_attribution_note: Nib second; tail approaches the right side of his face without covering either ear, paper or hands.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.text: The recording stays. The gate doesn't.
items.speaker_attribution_note: Off-panel Minho, left edge; remains entirely outside the phone and supporting hand.

items.speaker: PHONE SCREEN
items.native_qa_note: Visually verified in the unchanged source phone display. No overlay, repaint, substitution or punctuation added.

items.speaker: PHONE SCREEN
items.native_qa_note: Visually verified in the unchanged source phone display. No overlay, repaint, substitution or punctuation added.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: We could start with the ones still open.
items.speaker_attribution_note: Taeo first; unobstructed tail points down toward his visible head.

items.speaker: NIB
items.speaker_attribution_note: Nib second; tail points down toward his visible head. Both balloons remain in the upper extension.

items.speaker: PHONE SCREEN
items.native_qa_note: Visually verified in the unchanged source phone display. No overlay, repaint, substitution or punctuation added.

items.speaker: PHONE SCREEN
items.native_qa_note: Visually verified in the unchanged source phone display. No overlay, repaint, substitution or punctuation added.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: If my wall's in an old picture, I still want to know.
items.speaker_attribution_note: Nib first; clear downward head attribution, refolding action fully visible.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.speaker_attribution_note: Taeo is off-panel left. Tail terminates at the left frame edge.

items.speaker: COLLEAGUE
items.text: Minho. Can you check this strap?
items.speaker_attribution_note: Colleague off-panel right, matching the direction of Minho’s turn.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.speaker_attribution_note: Minho answers the off-panel colleague; tail stays to the right of his head.

items.speaker: MINHO
items.speaker_attribution_note: Minho continues to Nib. Separate lower balloon and tail approach the left of Minho’s jaw/neck.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.speaker_attribution_note: Taeo first; tail ends in clear space beside his face.

items.speaker: NIB
items.speaker_attribution_note: Nib second; tail approaches the right edge of his ear/face without covering it.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: Grandma wants to know when I'll get there Sunday.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: How long will you be gone?

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: If you'd like. I'll ask her.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: Noon on Sunday, if that's okay.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: His name's Nib. He's staying with me.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I awakened this week. I summoned him.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I'm all right. I went to the assessment office.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I didn't know how to explain it.

items.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
items.text: You can explain it on Sunday. Are you going into gates?

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: Nib's a goblin. He talks. He asked if he could come.

items.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
items.text: All right. Does he eat fish?

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: Then eat. Yours is going cold.
